gates.detector: held-out one-vs-rest AUROC >= 0.70 AND >= 20 held-out positives
gates.repair: >= 20 hard episodes AND Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.50 AND <= 10% of clean successes lost
gates.summary: claim "the suite ports" only if >= 15 of the 20 ported faults pass both gates; report every fault either way
